title: Stall watch sees a stalled agent, not only Bash jobs
why: A round-3 reviewer on #1186 stalled 1 h 54 min unseen, because stall_watch reads Bash jobs only.
note: Done check: a red test where --stop lists a running agent with a quiet transcript. Filed from coordinator 17:58 CST Nov 7. Built as #1682, with runner 8 (coordinator 18:38 CST). Follow-ups stall-watch-cases-run, stall-watch-open-call-cap and stall-watch-resume go to the same lane; the lane sends their details. Coordinator pick, 18:38 CST, can be undone: an agent's open foreground tool call older than 900 s lists as stalled, and background calls are skipped.
